name: De xao sa ot
summary: Mountain goat stir-fried with lemongrass and chili, one of the plates in the goat shops on the roads to the sights. Ninh Bình goat is firm, because the animals climb the limestone.
origin: Ninh Bình, on the same goat roads as dê tái chanh.
howToEat: Order it as a plate of goat with lemongrass and chili.
where: The roads and lanes toward Tràng An, Hoa Lư, and Bái Đính, where the dê núi shops are.
seoTitle: De xao sa ot — lemongrass goat
seoDescription: Ninh Bình mountain goat stir-fried with lemongrass and chili, on the goat roads toward the karst sights.
